observer.methodChange: Common refinement observer for every arm adds loaded source-SRJ/scenario hashes before timed solve and shallow raw-constructor rule declarations. Raw constructor hashing and synchronous phase/clock observer behavior are unchanged. Do not pool these timings with earlier observer cohorts.

details.limitation: Original loaded SRJ bytes are not saved by this observer. Its pre-solve digest/rule declarations are authenticated observer evidence; they cannot be independently rehashed from this archive.

details.method: Original file bytes, never normalized JSON. Remote absolute paths are mapped only to extracted hd-inputs/<validated basename>.
